=== Biochemistry ===
"ID":"demo-bio-1"
"Front":"The rate-limiting enzyme of glycolysis is ______."
"Back":"The rate-limiting enzyme of glycolysis is phosphofructokinase-1 (PFK-1)."

"ID":"demo-bio-2"
"Front":"______ is the committed step of the urea cycle."
"Back":"Carbamoyl phosphate synthetase I (CPS1) is the committed step of the urea cycle."

"ID":"demo-bio-3"
"Front":"NADPH is primarily generated by the ______ pathway."
"Back":"NADPH is primarily generated by the pentose phosphate pathway (HMP shunt)."

=== Pathology ===
"ID":"demo-path-1"
"Front":"Caseating granulomas are classically associated with ______."
"Back":"Caseating granulomas are classically associated with tuberculosis."

"ID":"demo-path-2"
"Front":"Reed-Sternberg cells are seen in ______ lymphoma."
"Back":"Reed-Sternberg cells are seen in Hodgkin lymphoma."

"ID":"demo-path-3"
"Front":"Apple-green birefringence with Congo red indicates ______."
"Back":"Apple-green birefringence with Congo red indicates amyloid."

=== Cardiovascular System ===
"ID":"demo-cv-1"
"Front":"The most common cause of sudden cardiac death in young athletes is ______."
"Back":"The most common cause of sudden cardiac death in young athletes is hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM)."

"ID":"demo-cv-2"
"Front":"ST-elevation in leads II, III, and aVF suggests ______ STEMI."
"Back":"ST-elevation in leads II, III, and aVF suggests inferior STEMI (often RCA)."

"ID":"demo-cv-3"
"Front":"Beck's triad (hypotension, muffled heart sounds, JVD) suggests ______."
"Back":"Beck's triad (hypotension, muffled heart sounds, JVD) suggests cardiac tamponade."

=== Renal, Urinary Systems & Electrolytes ===
"ID":"demo-renal-1"
"Front":"Muddy brown casts are characteristic of ______."
"Back":"Muddy brown casts are characteristic of acute tubular necrosis (ATN)."

"ID":"demo-renal-2"
"Front":"RBC casts are most suggestive of ______."
"Back":"RBC casts are most suggestive of glomerulonephritis."

"ID":"demo-renal-3"
"Front":"Hyperkalemia with peaked T waves should be treated first with ______."
"Back":"Hyperkalemia with peaked T waves should be treated first with IV calcium (stabilize cardiac membrane)."

=== Pharmacology ===
"ID":"demo-pharm-1"
"Front":"______ is the antidote for acetaminophen overdose."
"Back":"N-acetylcysteine is the antidote for acetaminophen overdose."

"ID":"demo-pharm-2"
"Front":"Digoxin toxicity is treated with ______."
"Back":"Digoxin toxicity is treated with digoxin-specific antibody fragments (Digibind)."

"ID":"demo-pharm-3"
"Front":"______ is first-line for anaphylaxis."
"Back":"Intramuscular epinephrine is first-line for anaphylaxis."
